SETTINGS.autoDamageTT: Should damage be automatically rolled if a hit is scored?

SETTINGS.automateLightingTT: If this option is disabled the lighting ActiveEffects will be ignored.
SETTINGS.automateVisionTT: If this option is disabled the vision ActiveEffects will be ignored.
SETTINGS.combatAutomateRangeModsTT: Apply modifiers to S/M/L range weapon attacks using distance between source and target token.
SETTINGS.combatFiringIntoMeleeTT: During combat, a missile or thrown weapon fired at a figure in melee is aimed at a random figure in that melee, weighted by size. The attack roll is then made against the figure chosen.
SETTINGS.ctShowOnlyVisibleTT: Show only visible. Player can only see tokens in Combat Tracker that can be seen with their character in scene.
SETTINGS.debugModeTT: Additional console log output, view using F12.
SETTINGS.extraDamageTypesTT: Custom Damage Types. Comma-separated list of additional damage types (e.g. holy, sun, ray)
SETTINGS.encumbranceIncludeCoinTT: Include coins in calculation of actor encumbrance values
SETTINGS.floatingHudAllowPlayerTT: Enable Combat HUD, when selecting owned tokens
SETTINGS.floatingHudAutoCloseTT: Automatically close HUD when token unselected.
SETTINGS.floatingHudStaticPositionTT: Position is at previous HUD location, otherwise always below selected token
SETTINGS.combatHudDensityTT: Compact reduces button and icon sizes for a smaller footprint.
SETTINGS.identificationActorTT: Unidentified actor's name will be masked
SETTINGS.identificationItemTT: Unidentified item's name will be masked
SETTINGS.combineStackTT: Attempt to find similar items in inventory on drop, and combine them.
SETTINGS.macroDontCloneOnDropTT: If a matching macro already exists, DO NOT create a COPY. Tip: Give your players 'limited' permission to prevent global deletions.
SETTINGS.InitiativeAscendingTT: Should initiative use ascending (low to high) order?
SETTINGS.initiativeFormulaTT: Formula of the dice rolls for initative.
SETTINGS.initiativeUseSpeedTT: Using spell or weapon will trigger initiative roll including cast time or speed factor.
SETTINGS.trackAttacksPerRoundTT: Track each weapon's remaining attacks for the round. Resets at the start of each round. Displays in the combat HUD and weapon list.
SETTINGS.initManualRollsTT: All initiative rolls must be manually triggered.
SETTINGS.initRoundSoundTT: Play sound to all players when a new round starts
SETTINGS.startCombatSoundTT: Play sound to all players when combat begins
SETTINGS.initSideVSideTT: When enabled roll initiative for each side only.
SETTINGS.initTurnSoundTT: Play sound to player when it is their turn
SETTINGS.initVolumeSoundTT: Volume used for sounds played during initiative triggers.
SETTINGS.itemBrowserMarginTT: Cost multiplier (-100 to 100) applied to Item Browser entries (default 0).
SETTINGS.npcLootableTT: Characters loot dead npcs by clicking on the dead npc token.
SETTINGS.npcMinimumHPPercentTT: When an NPC token is dropped on a map and its hit points come from a dice roll, raise the result to at least this percentage of the highest the formula could roll. Example: 10d10 can roll at most 100, so at 80% a roll of 60 becomes 80. Set to 0 to use the roll exactly as it came up.
SETTINGS.nPCNumberedNameTT: NPC tokens will have a unique random number appended to it's name for reference.
SETTINGS.optionNegativeHPTT: Allow PCs to go to -10 hp before marked dead
SETTINGS.panOnInitiativeTT: When it's your turn, pan to your token in the scene.
SETTINGS.rollInitEachRoundTT: Enable to re-roll initiative each round, otherwise only when combat begins.
SETTINGS.systemVariantTT: System Variants: OSRIC, 1 or 2 (changes to systems such as, but not limited to, initiative, ability charts)
SETTINGS.useArmorDamageTT: Armor takes 1 point of damage per dice rolled, broken at 0 points
SETTINGS.useAscendingACTT: Display Armor Class on an ascending scale (10 = unarmored, higher = better). Variant 2 (THAC0) also shows a derived Base Attack Bonus. Attack roll math is unchanged; only the displayed values are converted.
SETTINGS.useAutoHitFailDiceTT: On a natural dice roll of 1 mis/fail fumble, on 20 hit/crit
SETTINGS.weaponVarmorTT: Apply attack modifiers considering weapon type versus armor type

TOKEN.AuraDistanceTT: Distance from center to edge of aura.
